title: Origin story: Horus
description: Horus was the son of Isis and the resurrected Osiris, conceived by magic and hidden in the marshes from his uncle Set. Grown, he contested Set for Egypt's throne in a series of trials before the gods, losing an eye in the struggle but winning the crown — the eye becoming the symbol of wholeness.

title: Ability profile: Horus
description: Ranked abilities: Falcon combat — rank 96/100; Kingship — rank 95/100; Sky mastery — rank 94/100; Endurance — rank 93/100; Justice — rank 92/100.

title: Power ranking: Horus
description: Powers: The falcon's all-seeing eye; The restored Eye — symbol of healing and wholeness; The double crown of united Egypt.

title: Stamina feats: Horus
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Fought Set for eighty years of divine trials; Endured the loss of his eye and fought on.

title: Crossover notes: Horus
description: Horus crosses naturally with: kingship, the sky, vengeance, protection.

title: Cultural impact: Horus
description: Every pharaoh was Horus incarnate; his eye is the most famous protective amulet in history.
